title: Grant report
description: The body of the signed POST /v1/grants, application/json, with which an adapter reports one grant of a connection: the access the source grants for one external account, which the adapter linked to connection_id under the connect pass whose nonce is pass_nonce (connect-pass.schema.json). A connection holds a list of grants, one per external account at the source, and grant_ref is the adapter's ref to the grant of one external account, stable for that account. The adapter reports a grant once it has minted a linked connect return for it, and again whenever a newer pass for the same external account replaces that account's grant: a report of a grant_ref the connection already holds replaces that grant. The control plane accepts a report only when pass_nonce is the nonce of a connect pass of that connection whose linked connect return it accepted, and refuses another, 409 pass_unknown. A grant is linked to at most one live connection, as connect-pass.schema.json says. On success the control plane answers a signed 204 with no body, and writes a grant entry, linked, to the change feed (changes.schema.json). The control plane's copy of a connection's grants wins: the adapter reads it with GET /v1/grants (grants.schema.json) and follows the change feed, and when its state and that copy differ, it changes its state to match the copy, dropping a grant the copy does not hold. The control plane decides rights first, in the order refusal.schema.json gives, then 403 connection_unknown, 409 connection_ended and 409 connection_suspended, for connection_id, then 409 pass_unknown. It is signed with the adapter's access key as definitions.schema.json describes. The control plane refuses a time more than 300 seconds from its clock, either way, or a request whose signature it has already seen, with an unsigned 401; definitions.schema.json has the replay rule. A member this schema does not define is refused, invalid_request.

version.description: The document format. The control plane refuses a version it does not read.

time.description: When the adapter built the body, RFC 3339 in UTC with whole seconds. The control plane refuses a time more than 300 seconds from its clock, either way, with an unsigned 401.

connection_id.description: The connection the grant is linked to, as the connect pass named it.

grant_ref.description: The adapter's ref to the grant: one per external account at the source, stable for that account.

pass_nonce.description: The nonce of the connect pass under which the adapter linked the grant, as the pass carried it.
